AIMA CLAUSE RESOLUTION MANUAL

1. THE PROPOSITIONAL KNOWLEDGE BASE
Every room (x,y) contains propositions: P(x,y) [Pit], W(x,y) [Wumpus], B(x,y) [Breeze], S(x,y) [Stench].
Axioms: B(x,y) <=> Or(P_adj) and S(x,y) <=> Or(W_adj).
Safe Room Definition: OK(x,y) <=> Not P(x,y) And Not W(x,y).
2. REFUTATION RESOLUTION PROOF (KB And Not Alpha |- EmptyClause)
To verify if cell (x,y) is Safe, we assume the negation: (P(x,y) Or W(x,y)).
We resolve complementary literals against known facts:
- If cell (1,1) has No Breeze, resolution derives Not P(1,2) and Not P(2,1).
- If cell (1,1) has No Stench, resolution derives Not W(1,2) and Not W(2,1).
- Resolving (Not P And Not W) against (P Or W) derives the Empty Clause [] (Contradiction).
Hence, OK(1,2) is mathematically guaranteed!
